UserChallengeProfile.title: UserChallengeProfile
UserChallengeProfile.description: Stores the user's sobriety challenge start timestamp, target days, streak records, and completed recovery episodes.

niyyahTitle.description: User's personal intention (Niyyah) or challenge goal title.

challengeStartMillis.description: Epoch milliseconds for the user's chosen challenge start date and time.

longestStreakDays.description: Longest strike-free streak achieved in days.

completedEpisodes.description: List of completed episode numbers (1 to 11).

UrgeLogEntry.title: UrgeLogEntry
UrgeLogEntry.description: Logs each urge victory or slip event with intensity, dhikr count, and reflection note.

outcome.description: Whether the urge was overcome or resulted in a slip.

triggerNote.description: Optional note about the trigger or reflection.

intensity.description: Urge intensity on a 1 to 5 scale.

dhikrCount.description: Number of dhikr/istighfar taps completed during the urge.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the log was recorded.

EpisodeReflection.title: EpisodeReflection
EpisodeReflection.description: User's completion status and personal reflection note for a specific recovery guide episode (1-11).

reflection.description: Personal reflection or dua note written by the user.

completed.description: Whether the user marked the episode as completed.

/users/{userId}.description: User's private sobriety challenge profile and streak configuration.

/users/{userId}/urgeLogs/{logId}.description: User's private urge victory and slip history logs.

/users/{userId}/episodeNotes/{episodeId}.description: User's private completion status and reflections for the 11 recovery episodes.
